entities.name: Uurg
entities.description: An anurid frog beast of Dominaria, a tadpole that escaped the Cabal and now roams Otaria eating whomever he pleases.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: A mighty frog beast bonded to the merfolk ambassador to the Cabal, who perished leaving eggs.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A group that intended to use Turg's eggs to create pit-fighters.

events.summary: Turg dies and leaves behind a clutch of eggs.
events.quote: he left behind a clutch of eggs

events.summary: One of the tadpoles escapes the Cabal's control.
events.quote: one of the tadpoles escaped their control

relations.note: Mighty as Turg himself; hatched from Turg's eggs.
relations.quote: a specimen as mighty as Turg himself
